# PRD — Fleet Telematics Alerts
**Version:** 0.9 · **Epic:** EP-07

## Features
| ID | Feature | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| F-07.1 | Raise an alert when a vehicle exceeds a geofence | Committed |
| F-07.2 | Dispatcher acknowledges an alert | Committed |
| F-07.3 | Escalate unacknowledged alerts after 10 min | Designed, not built |

## Roles
Dispatcher, Fleet Manager.

## NFRs
- NFR-1 Alert raised within 5 s of the breaching GPS fix.
- NFR-2 No alert lost if the alert service restarts.
